tests.description: Three short (200ms) effects back-to-back with no gaps (rapid sequential).
Short 300ms effects with 100ms conceptual gaps between them (short gaps).
Three 1500ms medium-length effects played sequentially (no conceptual overlap).
Long 4000ms effects with 1000ms conceptual gaps (slow sequential).
Two short 500ms periodic effects where the second starts half-way through the first (overlap).
Long 3000ms sine with a 1500ms ramp that joins after 1000ms (extended overlap).
Constant and sine both start at t=0 (simultaneous) for 2000ms.
Spring, damper, and friction all enabled simultaneously (t=0).
Constant base force, with spring condition enabled mid-way then disabled before end (via separate timing steps).
Three short 300ms sine pulses separated by 200ms conceptual gaps (periodic pulse train).
Long 5000ms constant base with short 500ms periodic and ramp overlays starting at different times.
Short ramp, medium sine, and long constant arranged with increasing start_ms to span the full timing range.
